body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Toshiba presented three innovative software applications designed to further simplify everyday tasks, on all laptops and netbooks featuring Windows 7 at CES 2010.

The applications - Toshiba Media Controller, ReelTime and Bulletin Board - will exclusively come pre-installed on all Satellite and Qosmio consumer laptops as well as Toshiba netbooks and select Satellite Pro, Tecra and Portég business notebooks starting on January 12.

Toshiba Media Controller is an app that makes it easier to stream video and music across a home network. Enhancing the Home Group and media sharing capabilities of Windows 7, Media Controller enables a user to effortlessly play files to or from other connected Windows 7-compatible PCs or play to Windows 7-compatible devices such as the Xbox 360 and digital media receivers.

With a simple drag-and-drop visual interface, users can easily view and select media to play on PCs connected to the home network whether they are wirelessly connected or wired create playlists and even stream media to multiple PCs at once. Once media is playing on another device, Toshiba Media Controller allows the user to play, pause, advance forward and backward and control volume.

ReelTime helps users easily find files based on when they were opened with a simple, fun visual history. Users can quickly scroll through automatically generated previews of documents, photos, videos and more, filter by file type or use the calendar to go back weeks or months.

Bulletin Board gives users fast access to day-to-day activities, tasks and projects in a simple, visual and fun way. Get creative when organizing projects with the ability to drag and drop photos, videos, links, documents and applications into one place. Personalize and organize the board by moving, rotating and resizing using gestures to fit personalized style. Bulletin Board also includes several built in gadgets such as labels, calendars, a clock and a to-do list, as well as a dedicated Toshiba Board, which provides easy access to software updates, network connectivity, user guides, technical support and more.
